items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: I’d be talking to him about Johnny Mandel and Al Cohn and Gerry Mulligan

ctx.x: Is it harder to write a 10-second spot than a 30-second spot?

Well you really have to, you know, it’s a bit like the playing thing that I mentioned earlier. You have to pare your focus right down into that precise moment. I mean it is a very interesting thing to do, and particularly like there’s a lot for New York, and my contact was Elliott Lawrence. So Elliott would come over to London, and of course I’d be talking to him about Johnny Mandel and Al Cohn and Gerry Mulligan, and he’d say, “Well yes, we’ve got this Ford commercial to do.” And I said, “Yeah, never mind that,…

Did you ever get carried away with, you’re working on a 30-second spot and you write something that you really like and you start adding and expanding and then an alarm goes off and it says all right, remember your task here, maybe set this aside and make something out of it later?
